$comment: Operator decision log (scripts/analysis/decision-log.mjs; Spec 124 R-HK). Imported verbatim from the committed chat record docs/reports/decisions/raw/2026-10-22-batch-z12/2026-10-22-batch-z12.json. `decision_vocab`, `routing` (the register and row that record each decision), `amendments` and `options` are added by the lane and are not the operator's text; everything else is re-derived from `source.raw` by `--check`.

decisions.question: Layer 2 repeated payloads stored once as set ids
decisions.recommendation: Intern losers, by_class (if repeated) and permitted_by_class as set ids with each distinct payload stored once (the form C / Q-H pattern), then re-measure on a random sample against the 10 % line (Spec 133 §m.112); do not raise the budget without a ruling.

decisions.question: Equivalence sample replaces the compute time budget
decisions.recommendation: resolve_bylaws audits every Nth lot uncached and again in reversed candidate order; run time is the runner's measure, not a compute budget (compute purity).
